newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Tupras buys 100kt gas oil, 50kt gasoline.
newsitem.headline: Turk Tupras buys 100kt gas oil, 50kt gasoline.

text.p: Turkey's state oil refiner Tupras said on Tuesday it bought 100,000 tonnes of gas oil and 50,000 tonnes of gasoline in recent tenders.
The company purchased 75,000 tonnes of gas oil from Tempo in tenders issued on June 27, to be delivered in three equal tranches between July 16-24.
The prices for the three tranches are at a premium of between $8.16 to $11.15 per tonne, based on fob Mediterranean Italy price quotations.
Tupras bought a further 25,000 tonnes of gas oil from Marc Rich to be delivered on July 12-14 at a premium of $8.20.

The company was also to import 25,000 tonnes of gasoline from Marc Rich at a discount of $17.53 per tonne on July 15-17 and to buy a further 25,000 tonnes of gasoline from Masefield for delivery on July 9-11 at a discount of $17.41 per tonne.
